set.body: User goal: neuroatlas should become the go-to resource for template transforms. Scope: qualify fsaverage/fsLR surface resampling, volume-to-cortex projection, later CIFTI and broader template coverage. Start with honest execution/status metadata and exact template/mesh identity; do not treat lossy projection as invertible. Coverage assessment and phased acceptance plan: plans/template-transform-coverage.md. V1 MNI transform release stays unchanged. This issue tracks implementation, which remains open after the assessment.
set.title: Expand qualified template transforms to surfaces and cortical projection
